dialogues.jp: なにごともない春休み。
dialogues.en: I'm reading a comic book on my bed after taking a bath.
dialogues.text: I'm reading a comic book on my bed after taking a bath.

dialogues.jp:
風呂にはいったあと、だらだら、とベッドの上
でマンガを読みふける。
dialogues.en: "Whew, I'm in heaven."
dialogues.text: "Whew, I'm in heaven."

dialogues.jp: 「ふぅ、極楽極楽」
dialogues.en:
It's good. I hope things will last like this without any
disturbance until the spring break is over.
dialogues.text:
It's good. I hope things will last like this without any
disturbance until the spring break is over.

dialogues.jp:
いい。できればこのまま何事もなく、しかも春
休みがずっと続いてくれればいいのに……。
dialogues.en:
I take a snack from my hand and pop it into my mouth. The
greatest thing is I don't get fat even thought I'm eating
this late at night.
dialogues.text:
I take a snack from my hand and pop it into my mouth. The
greatest thing is I don't get fat even thought I'm eating
this late at night.

dialogues.jp:
手から和菓子を作って口に放り込む。こんな時
間に寝ながら食べても決して太らないのが素晴
らしい。

dialogues.en: "It's not practical."
dialogues.text: "It's not practical."

dialogues.jp: 「……実際、使えねぇよな」
dialogues.en: I don't think it's useful in emergencies.
dialogues.text: I don't think it's useful in emergencies.

dialogues.jp:
いざという時になんの役にも立たない気もする
が。
dialogues.en:
But, when I am locked in somewhere with a pretty girl, I can
do mouth-to-mouth.
dialogues.text:
But, when I am locked in somewhere with a pretty girl, I can
do mouth-to-mouth.

dialogues.jp:
まぁ、可愛い女の子とどこかに閉じ込められ
たら、口移しであげたりできるのかも知れな
い……。
dialogues.en: "That's a dream."
dialogues.text: "That's a dream."

dialogues.jp: 「｛ゆめ／妄想｝だな」
dialogues.en: I wish I were in that situation.
dialogues.text: I wish I were in that situation.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「やほーい、お兄ちゃん♪」
dialogues.en: "Yoo-hoo, oniichan!"
dialogues.text: "Yoo-hoo, oniichan!"

dialogues.jp:
唐突に窓が開いて、ハイテンションのさくらが
飛び込んでくる。
dialogues.en:
The window suddenly opens, and Sakura comes in
energetically.
dialogues.text:
The window suddenly opens, and Sakura comes in
energetically.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ？」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ドロボーです♪」
dialogues.en: "A night attack."
dialogues.text: "A night attack."

dialogues.jp: ぺたん、とベッドにさくらが座り込む。
dialogues.en: Sakura sits down on the bed.
dialogues.text: Sakura sits down on the bed.

dialogues.jp: 「おぃ」
dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「今日はお兄ちゃんのハートを盗みに来たんだ
　も〜ん」
dialogues.en: "Hahahaha, I'm okay whenever you are ready."
dialogues.text: "Hahahaha, I'm okay whenever you are ready."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おまえはどこぞの大泥棒の三代目か？」
dialogues.en: "What are you okay about?"
dialogues.text: "What are you okay about?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「にゃはは♪　美人泥棒三姉妹ってのもあるよ
　ん」
dialogues.en: "I mean 'that' is okay."
dialogues.text: "I mean 'that' is okay."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ」
dialogues.en: "Haaah..."
dialogues.text: "Haaah..."

dialogues.jp:
ため息をつきつつ身を起こし、ベッドのへりに
腰かける。
dialogues.en:
Getting myself up with a sigh, I rest my butt on the edge of
the bed.
dialogues.text:
Getting myself up with a sigh, I rest my butt on the edge of
the bed.

dialogues.jp:
「今日のおまえ、なんかヘンだぞ。いつも以上
　にムダにテンション高いって言うか」
dialogues.en: "You shouldn't talk like that even if it's a joke, Sakura."
dialogues.text: "You shouldn't talk like that even if it's a joke, Sakura."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「みにゃははは、そーお？」
dialogues.en: "It's not a joke. I'm serious!"
dialogues.text: "It's not a joke. I'm serious!"

dialogues.jp:
にははと笑うさくらのその表情に、若干の違和
感を覚える。
dialogues.en: "Even if you're serious."
dialogues.text: "Even if you're serious."

dialogues.jp:
これはテンションが高いとかじゃなくて、どっ
ちかと言うと……。
dialogues.en: She squints at me.
dialogues.text: She squints at me.

dialogues.jp: 「なぁ、さくら……。お前、どうしたんだ？」
dialogues.en: Sakura drops her shoulders with disappointment.
dialogues.text: Sakura drops her shoulders with disappointment.

dialogues.jp:
「なんか、今のお前……無理してるように見え
　るぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"You usually compliment the way Japanese women are, but what
happened today?"
dialogues.text:
"You usually compliment the way Japanese women are, but what
happened today?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……うにゃ」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: ごろり、とさくらが俺の腰にへばりつく。
dialogues.en: "Are you drunk?"
dialogues.text: "Are you drunk?"

dialogues.jp: 「お前なぁ、人が真面目に……」
dialogues.en: "What did you drink? Liquor?"
dialogues.text: "What did you drink? Liquor?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Wahahaha!"
dialogues.text: "Wahahaha!"

dialogues.jp:
なにか雰囲気が違う。腰というか、膝枕をして
いるような状態で、さくらが俺を見上げる。
dialogues.en: "Good grief!"
dialogues.text: "Good grief!"

dialogues.jp:
さっきまでのハイテンションとは打って変わっ
て、妙にしおらしくなっている。
dialogues.en: What will Nemu say if she sees this?
dialogues.text: What will Nemu say if she sees this?

dialogues.jp: 本当に外見相応まで、精神的に退行したような。
dialogues.en:
"But I can't send you home like this, so, just take it easy
for a while."
dialogues.text:
"But I can't send you home like this, so, just take it easy
for a while."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃんはやさしいなぁ」
dialogues.en: "Thanks."
dialogues.text: "Thanks."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なにがあったんだ？」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……嬉しいことがあったんだよ」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「嬉しいことって、なんか雰囲気はそんなんじゃ
　ないんだが」
dialogues.en: "You are so nice, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "You are so nice, oniichan."

dialogues.jp:
猫の背をなでるように髪をなでながら、首をか
しげる。
dialogues.en: "Did anything happen?"
dialogues.text: "Did anything happen?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうだよね……」
dialogues.en: "I was so happy. I told you it was a celebratory drink."
dialogues.text: "I was so happy. I told you it was a celebratory drink."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なぁ、どうしたんだよお前」
dialogues.en:
"I bought a chocolate cake and Japanese sake because I was
so happy."
dialogues.text:
"I bought a chocolate cake and Japanese sake because I was
so happy."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「らしくないっていうかさ……さっきまでテン
　ション高かったのが、急になんか寂しそうに
　なって」
dialogues.en: "You may be right."
dialogues.text: "You may be right."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうだ」
dialogues.en: "Do I?"
dialogues.text: "Do I?"

dialogues.jp: 頬をかいて視線を逸らす。
dialogues.en: "Yes, you do."
dialogues.text: "Yes, you do."

dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、言いたくなきゃ聞かないけどな」
dialogues.en: Scratching my cheek, I avoid making eye contact with her.
dialogues.text: Scratching my cheek, I avoid making eye contact with her.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Well, if you don't want to tell me, that's okay."
dialogues.text: "Well, if you don't want to tell me, that's okay."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……うんん。多分……ボクも愚痴を言いたく
　てココに来たんだと思う」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「俺の部屋は｛ざんげ／懺悔｝室か？」
dialogues.en:
"Umm... probably I came here because I've a lot of
complaints to vent."
dialogues.text:
"Umm... probably I came here because I've a lot of
complaints to vent."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ココは……お兄ちゃんのいるところだよ……」
dialogues.en: "Is my room a confessional?"
dialogues.text: "Is my room a confessional?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "This is your room, you know that."
dialogues.text: "This is your room, you know that."

dialogues.jp: ざわっ、と背筋に震えが走った。
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: 背中に手を回して虫でもついたかと探る。
dialogues.en: I feel a chill down the back of my neck.
dialogues.text: I feel a chill down the back of my neck.

dialogues.jp: なんだ今の？
dialogues.en: I reach to my back to look for a bug or something.
dialogues.text: I reach to my back to look for a bug or something.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ケーキにロウソクを立てて、お祝いのパー
　ティーを開いたんだ」
dialogues.en:
"I had a party, putting the candles on the cake, pouring
sake into a cup."
dialogues.text:
"I had a party, putting the candles on the cake, pouring
sake into a cup."

dialogues.jp: ぽつぽつ、とさくらが語りだす。
dialogues.en: Sakura starts to speak little by little.
dialogues.text: Sakura starts to speak little by little.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ロウソクに火を点けて、部屋の電気を消して、
　お誕生日みたいな感じで……」
dialogues.en:
"I lit the candles and turned off the light in the room like
a birthday party."
dialogues.text:
"I lit the candles and turned off the light in the room like
a birthday party."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「クリスマスみたいできれいだなー、って眺め
　て火を吹き消したんだ」
dialogues.en:
"I blew out the candles, thinking how beautiful they were,
just like Christmas."
dialogues.text:
"I blew out the candles, thinking how beautiful they were,
just like Christmas."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そしたら……ぽたぽた、と涙が溢れてきたん
　だよ」
dialogues.en: "Then, my tears started dribbling down."
dialogues.text: "Then, my tears started dribbling down."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「は？　なんでそこで泣くんだよ？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Why did you cry then?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? Why did you cry then?"

dialogues.jp: 今の話のどこに暗い要素があったのか。
dialogues.en: I'm not sure which part was sad.
dialogues.text: I'm not sure which part was sad.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「いや、そしたら家の中がシーンとしててね、
　誰もお祝いしてくれる人がいないんだなって
　……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, it was dead quiet in the house, then I realized
nobody is celebrating with me."
dialogues.text:
"Well, it was dead quiet in the house, then I realized
nobody is celebrating with me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「自分がバカみたいでさ……」
dialogues.en: "I felt so stupid then..."
dialogues.text: "I felt so stupid then..."

dialogues.jp:
ここで、やさしい言葉でもかけられれば、かっ
こいいのだが。
dialogues.en:
If I could say something nice to her now, that would be
good.
dialogues.text:
If I could say something nice to her now, that would be
good.

dialogues.jp:
いかんせん、かったるい――とかバカみたいな
言葉しか浮かんでこない。
dialogues.en:
Anyway, it's a pain in the neck. That's the only thing I
could think of.
dialogues.text:
Anyway, it's a pain in the neck. That's the only thing I
could think of.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あと、ロウソクから白い煙がしゅるしゅると
　立ち消えていって……」
dialogues.en:
"After that, the white smoke from the candles went up into
the air."
dialogues.text:
"After that, the white smoke from the candles went up into
the air."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お婆ちゃんが死んだときのことを思い出した
　んだよ」
dialogues.en: "I remembered the day my grandma died."
dialogues.text: "I remembered the day my grandma died."

dialogues.jp: 火葬場の煙か。
dialogues.en: She's talking about the smoke at the crematorium.
dialogues.text: She's talking about the smoke at the crematorium.

dialogues.jp:
確かに、青い空に純白の布のような煙が立ち上
る光景はいまでも覚えている。
dialogues.en:
I still remember the image of the smoke drifting up into the
blue sky, looking like white silk.
dialogues.text:
I still remember the image of the smoke drifting up into the
blue sky, looking like white silk.

dialogues.jp: あの時のさくらの落ち込みようはなかった。
dialogues.en: Sakura was desperately sad then.
dialogues.text: Sakura was desperately sad then.

dialogues.jp: 「泊まって……いくか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want to sleep here tonight?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want to sleep here tonight?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: 恥ずかしくて思わず顔を背けてしまう。
dialogues.en: I turn my face away with embarrassment.
dialogues.text: I turn my face away with embarrassment.

dialogues.jp:
「お前……誰かにそばにいて欲しかったんだろ
　うが」
dialogues.en:
"You wanted to sleep in the same bed with somebody, didn't
you?"
dialogues.text:
"You wanted to sleep in the same bed with somebody, didn't
you?"

dialogues.jp: まぁ、その誰かが俺しかいなかったんだろうが。
dialogues.en: Well, the person's got to be me.
dialogues.text: Well, the person's got to be me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いいの？」
dialogues.en: "Are you sure?"
dialogues.text: "Are you sure?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「よくないこともない」
dialogues.en: "I don't think it's not a good idea."
dialogues.text: "I don't think it's not a good idea."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「回りくどいよ」
dialogues.en: "Why don't you say straight?"
dialogues.text: "Why don't you say straight?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うっさいなぁ」
dialogues.en: "Shut up."
dialogues.text: "Shut up."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「でも、やさし〜ね♪」
dialogues.en: "But you're so nice!"
dialogues.text: "But you're so nice!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うるさいっての」
dialogues.en: "I told you to shut up."
dialogues.text: "I told you to shut up."

dialogues.jp: ぐい〜、とさくらの頬を引っ張る。
dialogues.en: I pull Sakura's cheek forcefully.
dialogues.text: I pull Sakura's cheek forcefully.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うみ〜、ひひゃいよ〜」
dialogues.en: "Oww..., it hurts..."
dialogues.text: "Oww..., it hurts..."

dialogues.jp: なんとなく可笑しい。
dialogues.en: She looks kinda cute.
dialogues.text: She looks kinda cute.

dialogues.jp:
昔はさくらに迷惑ばっかりかけられていたのに、
今ではこんなことしても殴られない。
dialogues.en:
Sakura used to give me a lot of troubles. But now, even I do
this kind of stuff to her, she doesn't get back at me.
dialogues.text:
Sakura used to give me a lot of troubles. But now, even I do
this kind of stuff to her, she doesn't get back at me.

dialogues.jp:
時間ってのは、ちゃんと流れているものなんだ
な。
dialogues.en: I guess times have changed without us really noticing.
dialogues.text: I guess times have changed without us really noticing.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「う〜、なに笑ってるの〜」
dialogues.en: "Oooh... what's so funny?"
dialogues.text: "Oooh... what's so funny?"

dialogues.jp:
俺の手から逃げて頬をさすりながら、恨みがま
しい視線をさくらが送ってくる。
dialogues.en:
After setting apart from my hand, Sakura strokes her cheek
and gives me a resentful look.
dialogues.text:
After setting apart from my hand, Sakura strokes her cheek
and gives me a resentful look.

dialogues.jp: まぁ、それすらも可愛いのだが。
dialogues.en: I can say she still looks cute.
dialogues.text: I can say she still looks cute.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、お前、本当に妹みたいだな」
dialogues.en: "Oh, man. You're like my real sister."
dialogues.text: "Oh, man. You're like my real sister."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、元々が親戚だから……」
dialogues.en: "Well, we are blood related, basically."
dialogues.text: "Well, we are blood related, basically."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なに怒ってるんだよ？」
dialogues.en: "Why are you angry?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you angry?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「どうしてお兄ちゃんは、ボクの前に音夢ちゃ
　んに会っちゃったの？」
dialogues.en: "Why did you meet Nemu before me?"
dialogues.text: "Why did you meet Nemu before me?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
あんまりにも唐突で、一瞬、なにを言われてい
るのか分からなかった。
dialogues.en: I don't understand what she's suddenly talking.
dialogues.text: I don't understand what she's suddenly talking.

dialogues.jp: 「会ったって、いや、そんなこと言われてもな」
dialogues.en: "Meeting her first... how can I answer that?"
dialogues.text: "Meeting her first... how can I answer that?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「どうして音夢ちゃんは、お兄ちゃんと兄妹な
　のに血が繋がってないの……」
dialogues.en:
"Why is Nemu your sister even though she's not blood related
to you?"
dialogues.text:
"Why is Nemu your sister even though she's not blood related
to you?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「え？　なんなんだよ」
dialogues.en: "What? What are you saying?"
dialogues.text: "What? What are you saying?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃん……音夢ちゃんに抱きつかれたり
　キスしてって言われても、我慢出来るの！？」
dialogues.en: "Bro, if Nemu asks you for a kiss or hug, can you do it?"
dialogues.text: "Bro, if Nemu asks you for a kiss or hug, can you do it?"

dialogues.jp: さくらが強く首を振る。
dialogues.en: Sakura shakes her head fast.
dialogues.text: Sakura shakes her head fast.

dialogues.jp: 「いいから、ちょっと待て！」
dialogues.en: "Hold on a second!"
dialogues.text: "Hold on a second!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en:
I can't take a drunk seriously, but fortunately, she settles
down.
dialogues.text:
I can't take a drunk seriously, but fortunately, she settles
down.

dialogues.jp: 妹って単語がいけなかったのか。
dialogues.en: "Oh well..."
dialogues.text: "Oh well..."

dialogues.jp:
「なんて言ったらいいのか……ほら、妹みたい
　にってのは、｛・・・／可愛い｝の最上級の誉め言葉の例
　え――」
dialogues.en: I shouldn't have used the word 'sister'.
dialogues.text: I shouldn't have used the word 'sister'.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……もう、いいよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry about it. It's okay."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry about it. It's okay."

dialogues.jp: ゆっくりと、さくらが立ち上がる。
dialogues.en: Sakura stands up slowly.
dialogues.text: Sakura stands up slowly.

dialogues.jp: 「あぁ……いや、ごめん」
dialogues.en: "Oh... sorry."
dialogues.text: "Oh... sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ、違うよ。ボクがわがままなんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Hmm... it's fine. I'm just selfish."
dialogues.text: "Hmm... it's fine. I'm just selfish."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en:
"Muhahaha... I think I'm drunk. I'm going home to cool off
my head."
dialogues.text:
"Muhahaha... I think I'm drunk. I'm going home to cool off
my head."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさいでした」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry."

dialogues.jp: ぺこり、と頭を下げてさくらが窓の外に消える。
dialogues.en: Sakura bows in apology, and then leaves.
dialogues.text: Sakura bows in apology, and then leaves.

dialogues.jp: まいったな。
dialogues.en: Good grief!
dialogues.text: Good grief!

dialogues.jp: 窓の外から桜の匂いが吹き込んでくる。
dialogues.en: I smell the cherry blossoms through the window.
dialogues.text: I smell the cherry blossoms through the window.

dialogues.jp: 「……また、やっちまった」
dialogues.en: "I did it again."
dialogues.text: "I did it again."

dialogues.jp:
どうしても、さくらと一緒にいると昔みたいな
応対しか出来ない。
dialogues.en:
Every time I'm with Sakura, I act like when I was back in
the old days.
dialogues.text:
Every time I'm with Sakura, I act like when I was back in
the old days.

dialogues.jp:
同年齢の人間に子供扱いされれば、自分でも怒
るだろうに……。
dialogues.en:
I know I wouldn't like it if somebody my age treated me as a
little child.
dialogues.text:
I know I wouldn't like it if somebody my age treated me as a
little child.

dialogues.jp: 「でも、なんでだろう」
dialogues.en: "But, why?"
dialogues.text: "But, why?"

dialogues.jp: 胸に手を当てる。
dialogues.en: I put my hand on my chest.
dialogues.text: I put my hand on my chest.

dialogues.jp:
俺はさくらに興味があって、さくらのことを可
愛いとも思うのに。
dialogues.en: I am curious about Sakura and I like her.
dialogues.text: I am curious about Sakura and I like her.

dialogues.jp:
ちょっかいをかけるのも、口を滑らせることも、
他の人間よりも心を開いているからなんだろう
けど。
dialogues.en:
I can tease her, say the things that I shouldn't say, but
all of those mean that I feel comfortable with her.
dialogues.text:
I can tease her, say the things that I shouldn't say, but
all of those mean that I feel comfortable with her.

dialogues.jp:
「どうして好き、って感情がないんだろうな
　……」
dialogues.en: "But I don't know why I don't feel that I love her."
dialogues.text: "But I don't know why I don't feel that I love her."

dialogues.jp: ◆寂しそうなさくら◆
dialogues.en: ◆Drunken Sakura◆
dialogues.text: ◆Drunken Sakura◆

dialogues.jp:
夜になって、さくらが俺の部屋に窓から侵入し
てくる。
dialogues.en: Sakura came into my room through the window at night.
dialogues.text: Sakura came into my room through the window at night.

dialogues.jp:
いつもよりハイテンションな様子だが、その表
情には陰が差していた。
dialogues.en:
I could tell from the way she acted that she'd been
drinking.
dialogues.text:
I could tell from the way she acted that she'd been
drinking.

dialogues.jp:
嬉しいことがあってお祝いしていたが、ひとり
が寂しかったと泣くさくらを抱きしめてやった。
dialogues.en:
She was celebrating for her happy event, but she realized
that she was alone which made her sad. When I heard that, I
held her gently.
dialogues.text:
She was celebrating for her happy event, but she realized
that she was alone which made her sad. When I heard that, I
held her gently.

dialogues.jp:
その夜、一人になってから天井を見上げて考え
た。
dialogues.en:
Looking up at the ceiling that night, I wondered why I don't
have the feeling of love towards her.
dialogues.text:
Looking up at the ceiling that night, I wondered why I don't
have the feeling of love towards her.

dialogues.jp:
どうして自分がさくらに恋愛感情をもてないの
かと――。
dialogues.en: A relaxing spring break.
dialogues.text: A relaxing spring break.
